seo.title: Acceptable use
seo.seo_title: Nexora AI acceptable use policy for the services
seo.seo_description: Permitted and prohibited uses, security and abuse prevention, generated content, monitoring, measures, reporting. Draft template, to be completed and reviewed.

blocks.role: Gabarit juridique en brouillon : rubriques en place, informations à compléter.

translation.headline: Acceptable use.
translation.subheadline: Draft template: the usage rules expected of a hosting and AI service; each technical rule remains to be confirmed by the founder.

translation.title: The principle.
translation.body: Nexora AI's services are for legitimate business uses. Using the service unlawfully, harmfully to others or contrary to these rules may lead to measures described below [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

items.title: Illegal activities.
items.text: Any activity contrary to applicable law [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]

items.title: Security breaches.
items.text: Intrusion, denial of service, circumventing protections, unauthorized network scanning.

items.title: Unsolicited messages.
items.text: Sending commercial email without consent or an unsubscribe option, contrary to the anti-spam law [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]

items.title: Unlawful or deceptive content.
items.text: Illegal content, impersonation, fake reviews, phishing.

items.title: Intrusive collection.
items.text: Mass or covert collection of personal information.

items.title: Circumventing limits.
items.text: Circumventing quotas, rate limits or billing; reselling access [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

items.title: High-risk uses.
items.text: To be decided: uses Nexora AI does not accept, for example decisions about people without human supervision [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]

translation.title: Security and abuse prevention.
translation.body: Technical measures applied to virtual private servers and API access: per-machine firewall, outbound mail closed by default, rate and abuse limits. Actual list of measures in force [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: AI-generated content.
translation.body: A model's answers can be inaccurate. The user remains responsible for how they use them and for human supervision of decisions that commit their business [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Monitoring, reporting, measures.
translation.body: How Nexora AI detects abuse without reading customers' business data, reporting address, prior notice, suspension and termination, right of reply [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. Text [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

blocks.role: Liste de ce que le fondateur doit compléter ou faire valider avant toute publication.

translation.title: To do before publishing.
translation.body: This page is a template. It stays a draft, unpublished and not indexed, until the following points are settled.

items.title: Fill in the markers.
items.text: Every [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER] must be replaced with the real information; no value is invented.

items.title: Have a lawyer review it.
items.text: The text must be reviewed by a Quebec lawyer [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

items.title: Approve, then publish.
items.text: Only after these two points, remove the draft status and the indexing ban.
